Tender Notice
Tuesday, 04 June 2024
2212 Hits
Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram is interested in purchasing the under Grocery Items and Vegetables & Fruits for Dietary Services. You are requested to send your lowest Tender as per terms and condition along with the respective sample against the items as mentioned below in a sealed envelope addressed to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, marked as ‘Tender for Vegetables & Fruits’. Tenders should reach us on or before 15
th
June, 2024 up to 01:00 PM.
The prices quoted by you should be F.O.R. Sevagram / Destination inclusive charges and taxes etc. Failing which the Tender might not be considered.
The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to reject any or all the Tenders without assigning any reasons.
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
